defs.def: to move from one place to another; to move sth/sb from one place to another （使）转移，搬迁
to move from one job, school, situation, etc. to another; to arrange for sb to move （使）调动；转职；转学；改变（环境）
if you transfer a feeling, a disease, or power, etc., or if it transfers from one person to another, the second person has it, often instead of the first 转移（感情）；传染（疾病）；让与，转让（权力等）

ex.s: Andrew From Matt To Andrew Subject Re: Travel arrangements Hey Andrew, I’ve bought the plane tickets and arranged transfer from the airport to the hotel.
ex.t: 安德鲁从马特到安德鲁主题回复：旅行安排嘿，安德鲁，我已经买了机票，并安排了从机场到酒店的接送服务。

ex.s: The probe enters the Earth-Mars transfer orbit.
ex.t: 探测器进入地球火星转移轨道。

defs.def: to officially arrange for sth to belong to sb else or for sb else to control sth 转让；让与
to move, or to move sb, to a different sports team, especially a professional football (soccer) team 转会，使转会（尤指职业足球队）
to change to a different vehicle during a journey; to arrange for sb to change to a different vehicle during a journey （使在旅途中）转乘，换乘，倒车
to copy information, music, an idea, etc. from one method of recording or presenting it to another; to be recorded or presented in a different way 转存，转录（资料、音乐等）；改编
the act of moving sb/sth from one place, group or job to another; an occasion when this happens 搬迁；转移；调动；变换
the act of moving a sports player from one club or team to another （运动员）转会
an act of changing to a different place, vehicle or route when you are travelling （旅途中的）中转，换乘，改变路线
a ticket that allows a passenger to continue their journey on another bus or train 转车票；换乘票
a picture or design that can be removed from a piece of paper and stuck onto a surface, for example by being pressed or heated 转印图画，转印图案（利用挤压或加热，可从纸上转印到物体的表面）
the process of using behaviour which has already been learned in one situation in a new situation 迁移（将已习得的行为在新的情况下应用）
